summary: Sign new gate evidence with the Fractal predicate URI

schema.detail: The gate evidence v1 payload schema is unchanged.

rules.detail: Signature, trust and gate policy requirements are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Rust observers and evidence-sign emit https://compounding.tech/fractal/evidence/gate/v1. Rust and Python verifiers permanently accept both that URI and https://smalltalk.dev/evidence/gate/v1.

downtime.detail: No daemon or state migration is required.

manual.detail: The dual-URI verifier must be installed before consuming new signer output.

recovery.detail: Returning to the previous signer remains readable by the dual-URI verifiers.
